/// Stored state of a dungeon level when player travels to other floors.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct StoredLevel {
    pub level: DungeonLevel,
    pub monsters: Vec<(nethacked_arena::ActorId, nethacked_arena::ActorRecord)>,
    pub items: Vec<(ItemId, nethacked_arena::ItemRecord)>,
    pub unpaid_items: Vec<(ItemId, u32)>,

pub struct SimulationWorld {
    #[serde(skip, default = "default_ruleset")]
    pub ruleset: Arc<Ruleset>,
    #[serde(default = "default_ruleset_ref")]
    pub ruleset_ref: RulesetRef,
    pub level: DungeonLevel,
    pub levels: Vec<DungeonLevel>,
    pub current_branch: nethacked_types::BranchId,

equipment: crate::actions::equipment::EquipmentState::default(),
            scheduler: SchedulerState::new(12, 0),
            object_timers: crate::object_timers::ObjectTimerQueue::default(),
            unpaid_items,
            player_gold,
            player_nutrition,

pub struct ItemRecord {
    /// Owned archetype identity; absence retains legacy exact-name lookup.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub definition: Option<ItemDefinition>,
    /// Detached supported monster state (C oextra->omonst), never a live actor.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub saved_monster_traits: Option<Box<SavedMonsterTraits>>,
    /// Canonical C ART_* symbol; independent of display name.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub artifact_id: Option<String>,
    pub name: String,
    pub class: ItemClass,
    pub weight: u32,
    pub buc: Buc,
    pub is_container: bool,
    pub is_bag_of_holding: bool,
    pub enchantment: i8,
    pub erosion: u8,

pub corpse_age: u32,
    pub rot_threshold: u32,
    /// Times recharged (C `obj->recharged`, read.c:729); distinct from `erosion`.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub recharged: u8,
    /// Stack size; weight stores the total stack weight (C obj->owt).
    #[serde(default = "one", skip_serializing_if = "is_one")]
    pub quantity: u32,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "std::ops::Not::not")]
    pub poisoned: bool,
